answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 5596 Country: ZA Title: I am married to a man who's surname is rehman. is this appropriate and if not, would it be fine if he adds a middle name such as abdur..? Question: I am married to a man who's surname is rehman. is this appropriate and if not, would it be fine if he adds a middle name such as abdur..? Answer ID: 5596 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 199/199=M) Rahman is attributive name of Allah. One should not name oneself as ?Rahman? only, but it should be prefixed with ?Abd? e.g. Abdur Rahman. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
